intro: Explore a mysterious forest, uncover hidden paths, discover forgotten secrets and survive the dangers lurking among the trees.
description:
Step into a colourful woodland filled with animals, hidden discoveries and mysterious creatures.

Mathias has ventured deep into the forest, where every path offers something new to investigate. Guide him through peaceful meadows, dense woodland trails, flowing rivers and dark caves as you search for interesting objects and uncover the secrets of the wilderness.

Pay close attention to your surroundings. Follow scattered feathers, inspect abandoned campsites, examine unusual plants and mushrooms, and interact with the animals you meet along the way. Some creatures may need your help, while other encounters will test whether Mathias is brave enough to continue.

Every discovery shapes Mathias’s personality. Exploring unfamiliar places increases his curiosity, facing frightening creatures develops his bravery, and experiencing the peaceful side of nature brings him happiness. The qualities you develop during your journey will influence how Mathias handles the greatest mystery hiding within the woods.

Deep inside the forest lives a legendary Yeti. Will Mathias frighten the creature away, become trapped in its cave or discover that the mysterious beast may not be an enemy after all? His final fate depends on the experiences collected throughout the adventure.

Explore at your own pace, enjoy the charming low-poly environments and see where your journey through the forest will lead.

Features:

• Explore a colourful 3D woodland environment
• Discover hidden locations and mysterious caves
• Interact with animals, plants and unusual objects
• Develop bravery, curiosity and happiness
• Help creatures you encounter during your journey
• Uncover the mystery of the legendary Yeti
• Experience multiple endings based on your actions

The forest is waiting. Follow the trail, embrace the unknown and discover what lies deep within the woods.
